label: Metadata Stamp
description: Stamp each video's creation date (read from its metadata) onto the video as a small chip — 9 positions, deterministic date formats. Point it at a folder for one stamped output per input; files without metadata use your fallback text or pass through clean. (Defaults to bottom-left: the free tier's m0saic QR occupies bottom-right.)

sourceIds.label: Source(s)
sourceIds.description: Videos to stamp — pick a folder, one or more files, or drag-and-drop. One stamped output per input.

stampField.label: Stamp
stampField.description: What to stamp: the video's creation date from its metadata ("creation-date"), its filename, or fixed custom text.

dateFormat.label: Date Format
dateFormat.description: How the creation date is written on the video.

fallbackText.label: Fallback Text
fallbackText.description: Stamped when a file carries no creation tag. Leave EMPTY to render such files clean, with no stamp at all.
fallbackText.placeholder: (empty = no stamp when metadata is missing)

utcOffsetMinutes.label: UTC Offset (min)
utcOffsetMinutes.description: Show the date at this UTC offset (minutes). Unset uses the tag's own offset when it has one, else UTC — set this when cameras wrote plain UTC but you filmed in local time.

customText.label: Custom Text
customText.description: Fixed text to stamp on every input.

sizeRatio.label: Size
sizeRatio.description: Stamp chip height as a fraction of min(width, height).

marginRatio.label: Margin
marginRatio.description: Margin from the canvas edges, as a fraction of min(width, height).

chipColor.label: Chip Color
chipColor.description: Color of the rounded chip behind the text.

chipOpacity.label: Chip Opacity
chipOpacity.description: Chip opacity — 0 removes the chip and leaves bare text.
